declarations.docstring: Assigns a finite-dimensional representation of the general linear group to each natural-weight parameter over an algebraically closed field.
Produces an auxiliary finite-dimensional representation of `GL (Fin n, k)` from the given indexed parameter.
The natural-valued weight associated with the parameter is antitone.
Membership in the induced monoid-algebra submodule is equivalent to membership in the original invariant submodule.
Regards a submodule preserved by every element of the represented monoid as a submodule over the monoid algebra.
Defines the general linear group action on the first auxiliary space indexed by the parameter.
Over the complex numbers, the auxiliary general linear representation is simple when the sum of its natural weights is at most the rank.
Identifies the underlying auxiliary representation with the result of applying the displayed representation construction to the given monoid homomorphism and indexed representation.
Defines the general linear group action on the second auxiliary space determined by the indexed parameter.
When the shift is zero, the polynomial assigned to the auxiliary representation agrees with the polynomial determined by its natural weight.
The auxiliary representation construction from a scalar-valued monoid homomorphism preserves semisimplicity.
The auxiliary representation construction from a scalar-valued monoid homomorphism preserves simplicity.
